## Summary of PR/Issue

[PR #470](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/470) implements the metadata slice of [#469](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/469), part of the latency milestone in [#454](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/454). It replaces the model-backed metadata session for explicit non-issue `/implement` requests with deterministic typed title, body, and `base_pr` derivation. It also removes obsolete prompt, timeout, and workflow plumbing while preserving authorization, source links, closed-PR handling, and session-fork behavior. Current head `e67590e` passes the Test Scripts check and the reviewers’ focused test runs.

## Review

The refactor is well-scoped and achieves its latency goal, but the current ancestry inference can contradict explicit user intent and therefore is not ready to merge. Reviewers disagreed on severity; current code and #469’s explicit stacking requirement support treating that defect as blocking.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Stacking inference can choose the wrong base | BLOCKING | Context-free keyword matching can both stack unrelated “follow-up” features and ignore an explicit stacking request containing “independent,” silently producing the wrong branch ancestry. |
| Label-triggered metadata is not context-safe | WARNING | `agent/implement` label events have no live slash command, so they normally receive a generic title; stale `/implement` prose in the PR body can instead be mistaken for the active request. |

## Progress

- The metadata agent session and obsolete response/timeout plumbing are removed cleanly.
- Authorization remains enforced during final route resolution, and open/closed inferred bases remain validated.
- Documentation and focused behavior tests were updated; current-head CI passes.
- The label-trigger concern was already documented in the top-level rubric review, so it was not duplicated inline.
- Posted one focused [inline comment](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/470#discussion_r3562940602) covering the previously unreported negated-intent ancestry case.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Stacking inference can choose the wrong base</summary>

**Cause:** [`inferImplementBasePr`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/e67590e824df7e04810e29f391d6b8f8fbdf56d6/.agent/src/triage.ts#L163-L173) gives any `independent` match precedence over stacking matches, while bare `follow-up` is treated as stacking intent. Thus “Do not make this independent; stack it on this PR” remains unstacked, while “Add follow-up email notifications” is stacked.

**Candidate solutions:** Make matching phrase-scoped and negation-aware, or introduce a typed stacking signal. Add regression tests for both contradictory intent and domain uses of “follow-up.”

**Comments:** One reviewer considered this bounded and non-blocking; another marked it blocking. Because #469 specifically requires explicit stacked requests to preserve source-PR ancestry, the demonstrated false negative is blocking.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Label-triggered metadata is not context-safe</summary>

**Cause:** Label routing passes the PR title/body as `REQUEST_TEXT`, but [`requestWithoutImplementCommand`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/e67590e824df7e04810e29f391d6b8f8fbdf56d6/.agent/src/triage.ts#L123-L139) requires a live mention command. The typed context omits trigger origin and target title, leaving label text indistinguishable from slash-command text.

**Candidate solutions:** Pass trigger/source kind and target title explicitly, derive label-triggered titles from that context, and reuse the existing route extraction rather than independently scanning for `/implement`. Add a PR-label regression test, including stale command prose.

**Comments:** Reviewers ranged from INFO to WARNING. This remains a warning because dispatch still succeeds and the metadata is recoverable, but it regresses the prior context-derived label behavior.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step

`FIX_PR`: Both findings have concrete, localized branch changes and regression tests suitable for an automated fix pass.

## Final Verdict

`NEEDS_REWORK`

## Action Items

- [ ] Make `base_pr` inference phrase-scoped and negation-aware, with false-positive and conflicting-intent tests.
- [ ] Pass explicit trigger/source context into metadata derivation and add label-trigger coverage.

**Candidate solutions:** Anchor stacking matches to imperative ancestry language, cover explicit branch wording, and bind negation to the matched intent or conjunction-bounded clause. Add all three reproduced requests as regressions.

**Comments:** Claude’s probes did not include these forms; Codex’s finding was independently reproduced on the unchanged current head.
